world.title: Sharmila Mona Sinha: The third daughter who turned deficit into dividend and became a US Hall of Famer
world.summary: Sharmila Mona Sinha, raised in Calcutta, faced societal disappointment as the third daughter. Overcoming challenges, she became a successful leader and has served as CEO of Equality Now since 2022. Her achievements have earned her recognition, culminating in her induction into the US Hall of Fame. Sinha's journey highlights resilience and the ability to transform adversity into success.

world.title: India or China: Which country is sending most students to US universities? Top 10 list revealed
world.summary: India has become the leading source of international students in the United States, with 363,019 students enrolled for the 2024/25 academic year, a 9.5% increase. China follows with 265,919 students, a decrease of 4.1%. South Korea, Canada, Vietnam, Nepal, Taiwan, Nigeria, Bangladesh, and Brazil complete the top ten, with Nepal experiencing the highest growth at 48.7%.

world.title: Schools Blocked, Riots Spread Across France
world.summary: Protests in France have escalated, leading to the closure of over 400 high schools as students demand improved education facilities and funding. On Thursday, one-third of the country’s nearly 3,700 high schools faced disruptions. Clashes and arrests have been reported amid the unrest, prompting significant concerns from the education minister regarding the impact on students and educational continuity.

business.title: India to build domestic capacity in import-dependent sectors, rare-earth magnets in focus: Shaktikanta Das
business.summary: India aims to enhance domestic capacity in import-dependent sectors, with a particular focus on rare-earth magnets, according to Principal Secretary-2 to the Prime Minister, Shaktikanta Das. He emphasized that structural reforms will persist alongside initiatives to strengthen macroeconomic and financial stability, reflecting the government's commitment to reducing reliance on imports and fostering self-sufficiency in critical industries.

business.title: LTM, Cyient, Zen, Birlasoft share price target, stop-loss - IT stocks to buy for over 32% returns ahead of Q2 results
business.summary: HDFC Securities has identified several Indian IT stocks as potential buys ahead of the Q2 earnings season for FY27, predicting over 32% returns. Key recommendations include Larsen & Toubro Technology Services (LTTS), Mphasis, and Coforge, among others. The brokerage maintains a positive outlook on these stocks, suggesting they offer meaningful upside from current price levels.

business.title: IPO market turns quiet next week with 1 new issue, 29 listings lined up
business.summary: The IPO market is expected to be quiet next week, with only R K Fashion Accessories from the SME segment scheduled to open on October 5. No new mainboard IPOs are planned for launch during this period. This follows a busy schedule of IPOs over the past two months, marking a significant slowdown in activity.

technology.title: Does Temple 'stick to your skin'? Can you bathe with it, swim with it? Eternal's Deepinder Goyal answers
technology.summary: Eternal's Deepinder Goyal addressed inquiries about the wearable device, Temple, highlighting its secure adhesive Grips and comfort. Users can wear Temple during various activities, including showering, but should replace the Grip every two to three days for optimal performance. Goyal's comments aim to clarify the device's usability in everyday situations, ensuring users understand its functionality and maintenance requirements.

technology.title: Amazon launches redesigned Kindle lineup with new Paperwhite, Colorsoft models
technology.summary: Amazon has introduced a redesigned Kindle lineup featuring updated models including the Kindle, Kindle Paperwhite, and Kindle Colorsoft. The new e-readers boast enhanced designs, displays, and features aimed at improving user experience. This launch reflects Amazon's commitment to evolving its e-reader technology, catering to diverse reading preferences and enhancing the overall functionality of its Kindle devices.

technology.title: Tell us your tech picks and this Harry Potter quiz will sort you
technology.summary: A new 31-question quiz combines technology preferences with the Harry Potter universe, determining which Hogwarts house—Gryffindor, Slytherin, Hufflepuff, or Ravenclaw—participants belong to based on their gadgets. The quiz appeals to both tech enthusiasts and Harry Potter fans. Additionally, the article notes that Future and its partners may earn commissions from purchases made through provided links.

sports.title: Why Gavaskar was disappointed with Rohit's 92
sports.summary: Sunil Gavaskar expressed disappointment over Rohit Sharma's failure to convert his 92 into a century against West Indies. He hopes Rohit will achieve more ODI hundreds than his age by retirement. Gavaskar noted a change in Rohit's batting strategy since the 2023 ODI World Cup, emphasizing wicket preservation and converting starts into larger scores, enhancing the team's scoring rate.

sports.title: Avishka Fernando recalled to Sri Lanka's ODI side for tri-series in Pakistan
sports.summary: Avishka Fernando has been recalled to Sri Lanka's ODI team for the upcoming tri-series in Pakistan, marking his potential return to the format since February 2025. Sahan Arachchige replaces the injured Wanindu Hasaranga, while Charith Asalanka has been dropped from the squad. The series is set to provide an opportunity for Fernando to showcase his skills again.

sports.title: India Champions vs England Champions Live Streaming: When And Where To Watch WCL 2026 Match
sports.summary: India Champions will face England Champions in their second match of the World Championship of Legends (WCL) 2026 on Sunday, October 4. India enters the game following a 46-run victory against Australia Champions. Details regarding match time, venue, live streaming, telecast, head-to-head records, and team squads are available for fans wanting to watch the event.

health.title: Stanford Researchers Develop Test To Detect Bladder Cancer And Track Treatment Response
health.summary: Stanford Medicine researchers have developed a new urine test for bladder cancer that analyzes RNA to identify active genes in cancer cells. This method offers a less invasive diagnostic option compared to traditional liquid biopsies, which focus on DNA mutations. The test aims to enhance treatment selection and monitoring for bladder cancer patients, according to a recent study.

health.title: Air pollution causes increased coughing during night, says study
health.summary: A UK-led study, conducted by Professor Cecilia Mascolo from the University of Cambridge, found a correlation between increased air pollution and higher instances of night-time coughing, which can disrupt sleep. Researchers analyzed data from approximately 98,000 individuals across 32 cities in 12 countries. Nearly half of the participants reported coughing at night, highlighting the health impacts of air quality.

science.title: The Clerk Who Mailed a Formula for Pi
science.summary: In 1913, Indian mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan sent a letter to G. H. Hardy in Cambridge, containing various mathematical results. Among them was a groundbreaking formula for calculating pi more efficiently than previously known methods. While some results were incorrect or familiar, the innovative nature of Ramanujan's work took decades to fully understand and appreciate within the mathematical community.

science.title: Seamus Murphy and The Discipline of Distance
science.summary: Seamus Murphy's exhibition features a quote from James Joyce, emphasizing the complexity of human experience. The photographer's work spans various countries and eras, presenting images that evoke emotion without explicit explanation. The show invites viewers to reflect on their own lives and encounters, highlighting the universal themes of connection and memory that resonate throughout Murphy's photography.

science.title: Saturn at opposition tonight: What is the Seeliger effect and how to spot it in India
science.summary: Saturn reaches opposition on October 4, providing an excellent viewing opportunity for the ringed planet. This phenomenon occurs when Earth is positioned between the Sun and Saturn, making the planet visible throughout the night. Observers in India can also witness the Seeliger effect, which enhances Saturn's brightness. NASA highlights this event as one of the best views in 2026.

entertainment.title: Vijay Deverakonda Reveals Rashmika Mandanna Tells Him 'I Love You' 10-15 Times A Day: 'She Makes Sure I Express'
entertainment.summary: Rashmika Mandanna shared that she tells Vijay Deverakonda "I love you" 10-15 times daily, emphasizing the importance of expressing love to those close to us. The couple is preparing for their upcoming film, Ranabaali, set to release in theaters on October 16. This project marks their first collaboration after marriage, highlighting their personal and professional bond.

entertainment.title: Rachita Ram taken aback as fan pulls her cheek after clicking selfie, internet says actor handled it well but fans must respect boundaries
entertainment.summary: Kannada actor Rachita Ram experienced an unexpected incident during her birthday celebrations when a male fan pinched her cheeks while taking a selfie. The event sparked discussions online, with many praising her calm response. However, commentators emphasized the importance of respecting personal boundaries, highlighting that such behavior is inappropriate, regardless of the circumstances surrounding celebrity interactions with fans.

entertainment.title: Amid Dorothy Backlash, Karthik Subbaraj Says Film Has Made Men Reflect On How They Treated Transgender People
entertainment.summary: Karthik Subbaraj, director of the film Dorothy, remains steadfast in his vision despite backlash over its queer themes. He asserts that the film has prompted men to reflect on their treatment of transgender individuals. Starring Keerthy Suresh, Sanath, and Rishikianth, Dorothy has sparked significant discussions, which Subbaraj views as a positive outcome amid calls for boycotts and online criticism.
